input.question: On Ethereum mainnet, over the pinned block window, consider every OrderFulfilled event emitted by Seaport 1.6 at 0x0000000000000068F116a894984e2DB1123eB395 in which the offer transferred exactly one ERC-721 token of the collection 0x0000eC93127BAA929E58E97dd0095A2BFb38ec1D and every consideration item was native ETH or WETH (0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2). Call each such event a sale and its price the sum of its consideration amounts in wei. Return uint256 = the median sale price in wei over the window, taking the lower middle value when the count is even. If fewer than 3 sales exist in the window, report unavailable rather than a number.

definitions.sale: One Seaport 1.6 OrderFulfilled event whose offer transfers exactly one ERC-721 token of the collection and whose consideration items are all native ETH or WETH.
definitions.price: The sum of that event's consideration amounts, in wei.
definitions.median: The middle value of the sorted prices; for an even count, the lower of the two middle values.
definitions.missing: Fewer than 3 sales in the window means unavailable. Never substitute an ask, a bid or an older sale.
